name: The Morrow Stone
summary: At the Equinex Monolith, taking the artifact begins to drain the Stave of Equinex. You carry the Sparkling Stone and the stave back to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Back to Feathermoon Stronghold
sections.body: The Stave of Equinex begins to lose energy when you take the artifact from the monolith. Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold awaits word of what you found. Bring him the Sparkling Stone and the stave.

sections.title: Troyas's Findings
sections.body: After you leave, Troyas studies the stone and names it the Morrow Stone. He does not yet know its purpose, but believes anything hidden inside the monolith as it was must hold great significance. He will continue his studies and hopes you will stand with him.

aliases: where do I get this quest
faq.answer: It begins at the Equinex Monolith, when you take the artifact from it.

faq.q: Who do I bring the stone to?
faq.answer: Bring the stone to Troyas Moonbreeze at Feathermoon Stronghold, along with the Stave of Equinex.

faq.q: What happens to the Stave of Equinex?
aliases: why did the stave lose power
faq.answer: The stave's energy begins to fade as soon as you take the artifact from the monolith.

aliases: what quest comes before the morrow stone
faq.answer: It follows The Stave of Equinex, where you energized the stave beside the monolith.
